description: This file defines the DefaultUpdaterConfig class, which provides configuration settings related to updater behavior in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods to load configuration values, store settings such as max idle time, bulk size, polling interval, and background sync configuration, and overrides standard methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: DefaultUpdaterConfig
classes.description: Immutable class providing configuration for the updater component, including methods to construct an instance from a Config object and getters for various configuration parameters.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method that creates a DefaultUpdaterConfig instance from a Config object, using a specific path and enum values.

methods.name: getMaxIdleTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed idle time for the updater's operation.

methods.name: getMaxBulkSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum bulk size for processing.

methods.name: getShardingStatePollInterval
methods.description: Returns the polling interval for sharding state updates.

methods.name: isEventProcessingActive
methods.description: Indicates whether event processing is active.
